title: (RHBA-2017:2730) glusterfs bug fix update
portal_summary:
Updated glusterfs packages that fix a bug are now available for Red
Hat Gluster Storage 3.2 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Gluster Storage|Red Hat Gluster Storage Server for On-premise|3|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|7|x86_64
Red Hat Virtualization|Red Hat Virtualization Host|4|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat Gluster Storage is a software only scale-out storage solution that
provides flexible and affordable unstructured data storage. It unifies data
storage and infrastructure, increases performance, and improves
availability and manageability to meet enterprise-level storage challenges.

This advisory fixes the following bug:

* When the replication process creates an entry as part of self-heal, it uses the iatt buffer to send the create operation. Previously, entries were created regardless of iatt buffer validity. This resulted in an empty file with GFID xattr of all zeroes being created when an invalid iatt buffer was sent. Checks are now included to ensure that iatt buffer content is valid before creating the entry in this situation. (BZ# 1484460)

All users of Red Hat Gluster Storage are advised to upgrade to these 
updated packages.
